title: happy path: friend request received, then accepted
description: Originally a synthetic baseline: an inbound friend_request lands through the dial-out mailbox path, the recipient accepts, and the contact reaches relationship_state=friend with the matching flight-recorder entries. Promoted to synthetic-promoted: the ea-claude-111 investigation (2026-06-09, silent friend-request notifications) sent a real friend_request through the live relay mailbox to the production agent — enqueued/delivered/acked, contact surfaced as request_received — confirming the inbound half of this exact shape live. The local accept step remains a synthetic extension.
